stem: In the figure, points A, B, C, and D lie on the circle, and chords AC and BD intersect at point E inside the circle. Arc AD, which does not contain B or C, measures 100°, and arc BC, which does not contain A or D, measures 40°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle AED?
explanation: Draw chord AB. Inscribed angle ABD intercepts arc AD, so it measures 100° ÷ 2 = 50°.
Inscribed angle BAC intercepts arc BC, so it measures 40° ÷ 2 = 20°.
Angle AED is an exterior angle of triangle ABE, so it equals 50° + 20° = 70°. (In general, the angle equals half the sum of the two intercepted arcs.)
